title: Atomic Chat MLX Server Manifest
description: Schema for the remote mlx-server manifest. Atomic Chat core installs and updates mlx-server from it, and the desktop Makefile bundles the same build into the installer. The archive is downloaded from the upstream_repo GitHub release: this repository's for a build mirror-mlx.yml copied here, AtomicBot-ai/mlx-vlm's for builds before that. sha256 and size are mandatory: they are the only pin on what gets executed. backends/mlx-manifest.staging.json, the candidate slot, follows the same schema.

upstream_repo.description: GitHub repository whose release holds the archive: AtomicBot-ai/atomic-chat-conf (mirror-mlx.yml), or AtomicBot-ai/mlx-vlm for builds before it. The download URL is https://github.com/<upstream_repo>/releases/download/<tag_name>/<asset name>.

tag_name.description: Release tag, suffixed with the mlx-vlm fork commit the build was made at (e.g. mlxvlm-macos-arm64-07ba5a1). Released cores accept no other form. The commit hash carries no order, so clients order builds by published_at instead.

upstream_tag.description: Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm release the build is based on (e.g. v0.7.12). Clients ignore it; the hatchet pipeline compares new upstream releases with it.

published_at.description: publishedAt of the GitHub release the archive is downloaded from. Clients order MLX builds by this timestamp: a build is an update only when it was published strictly later.

backend.description: Stable backend id the client selects on. MLX runs only on Apple Silicon, so there is exactly one.

name.description: Asset file name inside the release; a bare file name, never a path.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the archive, from the asset's GitHub `digest` field.

size.description: Archive size in bytes; clients check it before hashing.
